DitherSwitch.fill: Texture of the shade when on and of the track when off: gradient, dotted, hatched or solid.
DitherSwitch.color: Colour of the ink when on.
DitherSwitch.size: sm, md or lg: tracks of 34 by 20, 42 by 24 and 54 by 30 pixels, rounded to whole cells.
DitherSwitch.bloom: low or high adds a glow in the ink's colour when on.
DitherSwitch.enabled: Drops to 45% opacity and ignores clicks and keys when false.
DitherSwitch.animated: A ripple from where you press.
DitherSwitch.toggled: Called with the new state when the switch is toggled.
